About us 
 Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital. 
 Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale. 
 Are you striving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us! 
 Job Description 
 Local IT & Support Metro Digital Romania Squad provide reliable IT support to employees, ensuring workplace devices, applications, accounts, and IT services operate effectively and securely.
 Your Responsibilities: 
Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support, both remotely and on-site. 
Troubleshoot Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, hardware, software, network, VPN, printing, and peripheral issues. 
Install, configure, deploy, replace, and maintain laptops and other workplace IT equipment. 
Support user accounts, authentication, MFA, Active Directory / Entra ID, and access-related requests. 
Support Microsoft 365 services including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications. 
Support meeting rooms, Teams Rooms, videoconferencing equipment, printers, and other workplace technologies. 
Manage incidents and service requests according to established ITSM processes and SLAs. 
Support employee onboarding, offboarding, equipment allocation, and asset lifecycle management. 
Follow IT security standards and escalate security incidents or infrastructure issues to the appropriate teams. 
Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, asset records, and troubleshooting procedures. 
Collaborate with infrastructure, network, security, application, procurement, and external support teams. 
Participate in IT projects, technology rollouts, migrations, office changes, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
Familiarity with Jira and Service Now as ITSM tools. 
Manage the Hardware Processes for end-users, including buying, indexing and delivery of IT assets via courier companies. 
 Required key competencies and qualifications: 
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills 
Windows and macOS administration 
Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Entra ID and Intune knowledge 
Basic networking knowledge, including LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, and DHCP 
ITSM / ticketing-system experience 
Good communication and customer-service skills 
Security awareness and attention to detail 
Ability to work independently and collaborate with specialized IT teams
